definitions.explanation: To advance quickly through audio or video content.

examples.japanese: CMを{早送|はやおく}りした。
{早送|はやおく}りボタンを{押|お}す。
{映画|えいが}を{早送|はやおく}りで{見|み}る。
examples.english: To watch a movie on fast forward.

notes:
{早送|はやおく}り refers to fast-forwarding through audio or video content. Used as a noun or with する as a suru-verb.

KANJI BREAKDOWN:
{早|はや} (fast) + {送|おく}り (sending) = fast forward

USAGE:
- {早送|はやおく}りする: to fast forward
- {早送|はやおく}りで{見|み}る: to watch on fast forward

MEDIA CONTROL TERMS:
- {再生|さいせい}: play
- {一時停止|いちじていし}: pause
- {早送|はやおく}り: fast forward
- {巻|ま}き{戻|もど}し: rewind
- スキップ: skip
- {停止|ていし}: stop

SPEED OPTIONS:
- 2{倍速|ばいそく}: 2x speed
- 1.5{倍速|ばいそく}: 1.5x speed

OPPOSITE:
{巻|ま}き{戻|もど}し (rewind)
